meta.name: add-wechat
meta.description: Add WeChat (personal) channel integration via Tencent's official iLink Bot API. Uses long-polling and QR scan — no webhook, no ToS risk, no paid token.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让应用接入微信个人号,扫码登录后即可收发私聊消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让自己的应用或机器人接上微信个人号收发消息
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your app or bot to send and receive messages on a personal WeChat account

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 接入个人微信渠道:从 channels 分支拷入微信适配器并安装 wechat-ilink-client,启用后用手机扫码登录,再把微信私聊或群聊接到指定 agent 组,由 Claude 代收代回消息。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 接入个人微信渠道,或走到 /setup 流程里需要添加微信时触发。

say.text: 帮我把个人微信接到 NanoClaw 上
say.note: 会从 channels 分支拷入适配器并装依赖

say.text: 扫码登录好了,把最近那个微信私聊接到 agent 组
say.note: 运行 wire-dm.ts,让你选目标 agent 组

say.text: 微信提示 session expired 了,帮我重新登录
say.note: 删 auth.json 并重启,重新扫码

howto.what_en: Adds a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw: copies the adapter from the channels branch, installs wechat-ilink-client, logs in via phone QR scan, then wires WeChat DMs or groups to an agent group so Claude replies.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a personal WeChat channel to NanoClaw, or during the /setup flow when WeChat needs to be added.

say_en.text: Hook my personal WeChat up to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter from the channels branch

say_en.text: QR login is done — wire the latest WeChat DM to an agent group
say_en.note: Runs wire-dm.ts and asks which agent group

say_en.text: WeChat says session expired — log me back in
say_en.note: Deletes auth.json, restarts, asks for a new QR scan
